// INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file to appsettings.local.json and configure your providers
// GitHub federation (TASK-033): Set Enabled=true, register a GitHub OAuth app, and export KOBOLDLAIR_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID / KOBOLDLAIR_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET. AllowedGitHubIds is a DENY-ALL allowlist of GitHub numeric user ids — add your own id or no one can log in. Requires Authentication:Jwt:Enabled=true.
// Provider config DB mode (TASK-073): Set KoboldLair:ProviderConfig:MasterKey (below) OR export KOBOLDLAIR_MASTER_KEY to move provider config into the database with API keys encrypted at rest. On first run the Providers list + user-settings.json + env keys are imported once, then the DB is the source of truth and the admin /api/v1/providers REST API (ManageConfig) edits it at runtime. Without a master key the server stays in legacy appsettings/env mode. Production should resolve the key from a Vault-backed secret.
